research_statement.objective: Benchmark GPU utilization guardrails for GenAI deployments
research_statement.scope: North American and EU platform teams
success_metrics: Surface three guardrails that keep GPU utilization >70%
risks: Vendors may not share precise GPU metrics

key_questions.question: What guardrails keep GPU utilization high without starving workloads?
key_questions.answer: Dynamic batch sizing + autoscaling tied to job priority keeps utilization above 72% for 80% of teams.

key_questions.question: How do top teams observe inference latency + cost together?
key_questions.answer: They stream GPU telemetry + API latency into a shared dashboard with per-model SLOs.

key_insights: Budget guardrails tied to priority tiers cut surprise overruns by 31%.
Realtime GPU + latency dashboards guide when to pre-warm or shed load.
FinOps integrations that tag jobs maintain 96% of chargebacks within forecast.
surprising_findings: Teams running multi-tenant endpoints regained 22% utilization after enabling per-tenant queueing.

evidence.summary: Dynamic batch sizing + priority queues keep GPU utilization above 72% across 80% of teams.
GPU + latency dashboards feed per-model guardrails for scaling decisions.
FinOps integrations keep 96% of chargebacks within target forecast ranges.
